outcomeNote: Rava resolves the difficulty about ben Azzai's question

segments.he: אָמַר רָבָא: הֶחְזִיק בַּדֶּרֶךְ אִיכָּא בֵּינַיְיהוּ, לְבֶן עַזַּאי חַיָּיב – דְּהָא בְּבֵיתֵיהּ אִיתֵיהּ, לְרַבִּי עֲקִיבָא פָּטוּר – דְּהָא הֶחְזִיק בַּדֶּרֶךְ.
segments.en: «Rava said:» The reference is not to one who already went to a country overseas; rather, it is a case of «one who set out on the way» but has not yet left his city in which «there is» a practical difference «between them. According to ben Azzai» he is «liable, as» it is «in his home» city where «he is» located at this time and there is no difference between him and one who is sitting in his house. «According to Rabbi Akiva» he is «exempt, as he» has already «set out on» his «way.» Even though he is still in his home city, he is preoccupied with his travels and his status is like one who has already gone overseas.
